snippet.title: Bionicle: Quest for Mata Nui - BIONICLE DAY Trailer (Fan Made Open-World RPG Game)
snippet.description:
Bionicle: Quest for Mata Nui is a free fan made open-world RPG game that is set in the universe of Lego Bionicle. Its been almost 4 months since we revealed Bionicle: Quest for Mata Nui. After 6 years of quietly working on this project, it was overwhelming to see the positive response and it was an experience I will never forget.

As a thank you to all of you, aswell as today beeing Bionicle Day, the team has been working hard to put together this new trailer, showing off our progress!

-

Set during the first year of Bionicle, it follows the story of the Toa on their quest to collect the 6 great masks of power to rid the island of Mata Nui of the evil influence called Makuta.

Join our discord server for more info and regular updates!
https://discord.gg/jTfxtbD
